note: RFC 4271 Section 9 requires removing routes named in a non-empty WITHDRAWN ROUTES field from Adj-RIB-In. TestRFC4271ReceivedWithdrawalRemovesTheRouteFromAdjRIBIn drives handleReceivedStructured with two announced prefixes then withdraws 10.0.0.0/8, asserting Adj-RIB-In drops to 1, Loc-RIB drops 10.0.0.0/8, and BestChangeWithdraw is emitted. TestRFC4271ReceivedWithdrawalRemovesOnlyTheNamedRoutes verifies unwithdrawn 11.0.0.0/8 stays in Adj-RIB-In and Loc-RIB and withdrawing an unannounced prefix removes nothing; storage TestRFC4271WithdrawRemovesFromAdjRIBIn confirms FamilyRIB.Remove selectivity.
